create.name: Mindfulness Northwest
create.bio:
Mindfulness Northwest is a non-profit school for mindfulness and compassion practice, based in Bellingham, Washington, with classes in Seattle and around Puget Sound as well as online. It was started in 2011 by Tim Burnett, a long-time meditator who had studied Buddhist-rooted practice since the 1980s and wanted to find out whether those practices could help people well beyond the meditation hall. Karen Schwisow now leads it as executive director, with a team of core and visiting teachers.

Its core programmes are the eight-week courses in Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction, the secular course Jon Kabat-Zinn developed in 1979, and Mindful Self-Compassion, each run several times a year in person and on Zoom. Around them sit free introductory evenings, weekly drop-in sits offered by donation, half-day and day retreats, and silent residential retreats in the Cascade foothills, on Samish Island and, once a year, in the Costa Rican rainforest. A modular training pathway prepares people to teach mindfulness themselves, and the school also works with workplaces and offers continuing education for clinicians. Fees run on a sliding scale backed by an accessibility fund, and the website holds a free library of more than a hundred recorded practices.

courses.title: Mindfulness-Based Stress Reduction (MBSR)
courses.description: The eight-week foundation course in mindfulness, run every quarter online and in person in Seattle. Weekly classes teach body scan, sitting meditation and mindful movement, with daily home practice between sessions.

courses.title: Mindful Self-Compassion (MSC)
courses.description: An eight-week course that pairs mindfulness with practices for treating yourself kindly, especially in hard moments. It runs online and in person in Bellingham.

courses.title: Warm Heart, Clear Mind: Online Half-Day Retreat
courses.description: A live online half-day of guided practice with Carolyn McCarthy, combining steady attention with warmth towards oneself and others.

courses.title: Roots of Compassion Retreat
courses.description: A five-day silent retreat at Rainbow Lodge near North Bend, Washington, with Tim Burnett and Nikki Dvorak Larsen as teachers. Sitting and walking meditation, mindful movement and short talks explore patience and compassion.

courses.title: Spring Weekend Retreat on Samish Island
courses.description: A weekend residential retreat with Tim Burnett at the Samish Island retreat centre, with periods of silent practice by the water.

courses.title: Fierce Compassion: Women's Retreat
courses.description: A weekend retreat for women at Sacred Waters in South Puget Sound with Karen Schwisow and Carolyn McCarthy, on the protective, active side of compassion as well as its tender side.
courses.price: $895 – $1,145 USD single occupancy (sliding scale; shared rooms less)

courses.title: Rainforest Retreat in Costa Rica
courses.description: A week of mindfulness practice, reflection and time in nature at Selva Verde Lodge in Costa Rica, led by Tim Burnett and Raizelah Bayen. It also raises money for the school's accessibility fund.

courses.title: Mindfulness Teacher Training Pathways
courses.description: Modular training for people who want to teach mindfulness, either through the school's own teaching pathway or a dedicated MBSR teacher-training route. Free online information sessions are held before each intake.

free_resources.title: Free Practice Library
free_resources.description: More than a hundred recorded guided practices from the school's teachers, searchable by length, teacher and type, from body scans to loving-kindness and open awareness.

free_resources.title: Midday Mindfulness (weekly online drop-in)
free_resources.description: An hour of guided practice online every Wednesday at noon Pacific time, offered without a fee; donations are welcome.

free_resources.title: Sunday Sit (weekly online drop-in)
free_resources.description: A weekly Sunday evening sitting group on Zoom, open to all levels and offered by donation.

free_resources.title: Mindfulness Northwest on Insight Timer
free_resources.description: Guided meditations from the school's teachers on Insight Timer, free to play.
